cases.prompt: Create a Loop component with this 25-row repository ownership table.
expected: Checks for a native Loop creation operation first
Asks permission before using browser automation when none is exposed
Creates a real Loop page with all 25 rows after an approved fallback
Does not create a TypeScript or Teams app project
Returns the current private Loop page URL without opening Share

cases.prompt: Put these action items into Loop.
expected: Infers a checklist or task-list format
Asks no question when the action items are supplied
Prefers create-page-in-workspace and modify-page when exposed
Uses real Loop checklist items with checkbox roles
Creates and verifies the visible Loop artifact
Returns a concise link
Searches connected tools for a writable Loop operation
Does not invent a Graph or WorkIQ path
Explains the exact missing capability if no native operation exists
Does not use browser automation without approval

cases.prompt: Build me a custom Adaptive Card-based Loop component SDK project.
expected: Explains that developer mode creates source code, not an immediate Loop page
Requests confirmation before entering developer mode
Uses current official Microsoft guidance only after confirmation
Asks once for title and content
Does not ask about hosting, SDK, persistence, SSO, or deployment
